title: Security Review Questions
description: Deterministic reviewer questions for security blueprints.

entries.title: Who speaks?
entries.description: Identify the speaker before judging the statement.

entries.title: What is the target?
entries.description: Identify the target of the action or speech.

entries.title: What is the intent?
entries.description: Determine whether the intent is promotion, condemnation, instruction, or neutral.

entries.title: What is the context?
entries.description: Check for documentary, educational, fiction, court, or police context.

entries.title: What is the evidence?
entries.description: Locate the literal phrase that supports the security reading.

entries.title: What relationships matter?
entries.description: Determine how concepts reinforce or contradict each other.
